scope: Independent native photovoltaic cell response to an irradiance step with parallel R-C load. The reference supplies a later local-equivalent and grid-interface validation.

reference.basis: Reuse the previously qualified stock cell, parameters and same-row solved meter routing.

fixture.connections: Stock PV cell feeds a 0.25-ohm resistor and 0.02-F capacitor in parallel. All negative ends connect to ground. An independent load voltage and two current meters read the solved node and the load branches.
fixture.directions: Positive PV current flows from PV+ into the node. Positive resistor and capacitor currents flow from the load node to ground. PV voltage is Vpos minus Vneg. Convert native kV and kA to volts and amps by multiplying by 1000.

timing.rules: Use half-open windows on original integer ticks. On positive ticks, issue 1000 W/m2 until the step tick and 900 W/m2 from that tick. Keep the original zero row and all endpoint pairs through the irradiance step. Compare common native ticks directly.

native.archive: Separate run directories retain their installed tool hashes, input snapshot, actual generated electrical model, original OUT/INF and native process receipt.

physics.branch: Check original same-row PV and external voltages, Vload=R Iload, and Ipv=Iload+Ic.
physics.interval: For each pair of original rows check C delta(V)=h mean(Ic) and delta(C V^2/2)=h mean(V) (mean(Ipv)-mean(Iload)). Retain all startup and event intervals.
physics.discharge: Use the signed capacitor-current mean in the discharge window and compare stored energy at the irradiance step to the last row before 99 ms.
physics.convergence: Compare whole trajectories at common ticks. The tighter current gate applies outside the two declared startup and irradiance switching neighborhoods. Check two independent steady windows against the measured 0.25-ohm static points.
